# InnVox — Digital Engineering & AI Automation Agency

> InnVox builds custom web applications, agentic AI voice/chat automations, WhatsApp growth systems, and precision digital marketing for businesses across India and the GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain).

## Core Capabilities & Services

1. **Custom Web Application Development**:
   - High-performance Next.js & React web applications.
   - E-commerce stores, custom admin panels, inventory management, and online payment integrations.
   - Sub-second page loads, mobile-first UX, and 3D web features.

2. **Agentic AI & Voice Automation**:
   - 24/7 AI Voice Agents for instant phone enquiry handling.
   - Smart WhatsApp & Website chatbots for automated lead qualification.
   - Custom workflow automations using OpenAI API, Twilio, and CRM integrations.

3. **WhatsApp Marketing & CRM Automation**:
   - Direct lead capture from Meta ads into WhatsApp.
   - Automated broadcast messaging, appointment reminders, and order updates.

4. **Digital Marketing & Growth**:
   - High-ROI Meta Ads management (Instagram & Facebook).
   - Local SEO optimization and conversion rate optimization (CRO).

## Regions Served

- **India**: New Delhi, Patna, Mumbai, Bangalore, Pan-India.
- **GCC Region**: United Arab Emirates (Dubai, Abu Dhabi), Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah), Qatar (Doha), Bahrain.

## Verified Client Case Studies

- **Minara Gifting** (https://www.minaragifting.com/): Scaled from Instagram DM selling to a complete custom e-commerce web application with admin portal and automated payment integrations.
- **Sangat Motor Centre** (Patna, Bihar): Premium car care platform featuring a 3D car configurator and 15-second slide-to-book service flow.
- **Al Harmain Islamic Institute**: Student enquiry portal and automated lead capture system resulting in 4x lead growth.
- **Hygiena** (https://hygienaofficial.com/): E-commerce store with 50% lower cart abandonment rate.

## Pricing Models & Service Options

- **Website as a Service (WaaS)**: Monthly subscription plans starting from ₹9,999/month ($120 USD) for turn-key website development, maintenance, and automation.
- **Custom Project Engineering**: Fixed milestone-based quotes for complex web platforms and AI agents.

## Technical Stack

- **Frontend**: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js / Spline 3D.
- **Backend & Database**: Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Firebase, MongoDB.
- **AI & Messaging**: OpenAI API, Twilio, WhatsApp Business API.
- **Cloud & DevOps**: Vercel, AWS, Docker.
